contentBody.description: Based on your customer's requirements, the solution build for the Gaudi POC has to be on-prem. Please follow the below steps to complete the POC successfully.

sections.content: Many customer's have their preferred OEM that they would like to utilize for their solutions. Identify your customer's preferred OEM and engage wit the Category Sales business development team on next steps. Megan Gawlik will be able to discuss the availability for on-prem POC options.

On-Prem POC's require a business justification with the OEM team leads on why the POC needs to be preformed on-prem instead of in ITDC. The Category team will pull in the proper OEM Business leader to join the discussion. Bring and discuss any technical requirements for this POC.

The Category and OEM team teams will review and prioritize against other POC requests.

After discussions and prioritization, the goal is to receive a green light for the on-prem POC with the desired OEM from both the business and the technical teams involved in the POC.

After the decision, your customer will be assigned an OEM POC Experience Manager.

To begin the POC, we will need customer and OEM to sign the necessary loan agreements in order to kick off the POC.

Your customer's on-premise POC is shipped from the OEM to the customer's preferred site. You can engage with your OEM counterparts and team to track POC shipment status.

Once the shipment arrives, your customer, the POC Experience Manager, and yourself can support the onsite delivery and system bring up / turn on.

Now the system is turned on and ready to go, deploy the solution and begin your POC.

With the system in hand and turned on, your customer's technical teams may need support on how to develop with Gaudi. Here is the link to the Habana Developer site for them to learn and walk through all the details on getting started to optimizations on Gaudi.

Additionally, there are many validated software models on Gaudi today. For support throughout the POC, here is the Gaudi Software Roadmap that lists the current validated models as well as upcoming optimized models and updates.

OEM's will provide the support of the POC to the customer. The OEM will lean on the Category Sales team TSS and/or Habana BU Engineering team as they need additional help. They will follow the process defined through the Jira Service Desk.

From here, the POC deploys as planned to competition.
